News Flash
Information for Voters: Nov. 3 Election
City News
Posted on October 17, 2026
MELROSE, Mass. —
Melrose voters can cast their ballot for the November 3, 2026 General Election in one of three ways: In-person Early Voting, Vote by Mail, or In-person on Election Day. A sample ballot is
available for review
.
The deadline to register to vote is Saturday, October 24 by 5 p.m. The City Clerk’s Office will be open until 5 p.m. on Saturday, October 24 for any eligible voter seeking to register. Eligible individuals can also
register to vote online
.
Vote By Mail
Mail-in ballots will be mailed to voters who have completed a
request to
vote by mail
. The Melrose Elections office has mailed out all ballots requested to date, and the deadline to request a mail-in ballot is Tuesday, October 27 at 5 p.m. Ballots can be returned in one of the following ways:
Mailing it back in the postage-paid envelope provided;
Hand-delivering your ballot to the Elections office at City Hall during normal business hours and early voting hours; or
Using the secure ballot drop box located in the alleyway between City Hall and the Melrose post office.
Mail-in ballots cannot be dropped off at a polling place on Election Day.
Early Voting Begins Oct. 17
Early in-person voting will begin on Saturday, October 17 from 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. at Melrose City Hall, 562 Main St. The full Early Voting schedule, including weekday and weekend hours,
can be found at here
and the last day for Early Voting is Friday, October 30.
In-person Voting on Nov. 3
Election Day voting for all Melrose voters is held at the Melrose Veterans Memorial Middle School, 90 Melrose St., from 7 a.m. to 8 p.m.
Rides to the polls are available for all Melrose residents. The Council on Aging minibus will visit all local senior housing buildings, drive voters to the polls, and wait for all passengers to reboard before returning to each building. No reservations are required for the shuttle. Residents of any age who need a ride to the polls can call the Council on Aging at 781-665-4304 to schedule an individual pick-up during business hours.
The senior housing shuttle schedule is as follows:
